title: Copilot Studio: discover and use shared plugins from Microsoft's plugin registry
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and distinguishes the planned registry integration from existing plugin administration. The documented control paths, automation and licensing background are supported; registry-specific defaults, charges and control applicability remain appropriately qualified.

claims.quote: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry

claims.claim: The planned connection makes it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors and other capabilities.
claims.quote: making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities.
